name: State earned income credit
valueBasis: A percentage of the federal Earned Income Tax Credit, set by the state.

criteria.instructions: Would this household file a state income tax return? A state credit is claimed on the state return.
criteria.askIfUnsure: Do you file a state tax return?
criteria.assumption: you file a state tax return
criteria.note: A state credit has to be claimed on a state return, which most working households file.
